ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A metal rod of length L and cross-sectional area S has a material resistivity of ρ. The number of free electrons per unit volume in the rod is n, the mass of an electron is m, and the amount of charge is e. When a constant voltage is applied across the two ends of the rod, a current is produced in the rod, and the average speed of the directed motion of the free electrons is v. Then the magnitude of the electric field strength inside the metal rod is (　　)

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A metal rod of length L and cross-sectional area S has a material resistivity of ρ. The number of free electrons per unit volume in the rod is n, the electron mass is m, and the amount of charge is e. After a constant voltage is applied across the two ends of the rod, a current is produced in the rod, and the average speed of the directed motion of the free electrons is v. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The problem gives that the number density of free electrons is n, the magnitude of the charge of a single electron is e, the average speed of directed motion is v, and the cross-sectional area of the metal rod is S; therefore the magnitude of the current through the metal rod is I = neSv. The metal rod has length L, cross-sectional area S, and resistivity ρ; from the resistance law, R = ρL/S. When a constant voltage is applied across the two ends of the rod, the electric field inside the rod can be regarded as uniform, the voltage U = IR, and the magnitude of the electric field strength E = U/L. Combining these gives E = IR/L = (neSv)(ρL/S)/L = ρnev.

raw_record.question_text: A metal rod of length L and cross-sectional area S has a material resistivity of ρ. The number of free electrons per unit volume in the rod is n, the electron mass is m, and the amount of charge is e. After a constant voltage is applied across the two ends of the rod, a current is produced in the rod, and the average speed of the directed motion of the free electrons is v. method.method_draft: 先由题文给出的自由电子数密度 n、单个电子电荷量 e、定向平均速率 v 和横截面积 S，写出金属棒中的电流大小 I = neSv。再由电阻定律得金属棒电阻 R = ρL/S。恒定电压下棒内电场近似均匀，电压 U = IR，同时 E = U/L。联立得 E = (IR)/L = (neSv)(ρL/S)/L = ρnev。
method.CoT_raw: 题中给出自由电子数密度为 n，单个电子电荷量大小为 e，定向运动平均速率为 v，金属棒横截面积为 S，因此通过金属棒的电流大小为 I = neSv。金属棒长度为 L、横截面积为 S、电阻率为 ρ，由电阻定律得 R = ρL/S。棒两端加恒定电压时，棒内电场可视为均匀，电压 U = IR，且电场强度大小 E = U/L。联立可得 E = IR/L = (neSv)(ρL/S)/L = ρnev。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer ρnev is exactly the same expression as the standard answer \(\rho n e v\), just written without spaces.

answer_match_part_results.reason: Both represent the electric field magnitude as the product of resistivity, electron number density, electron charge magnitude, and drift speed.
